newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom's Saleh to address Thurs news conference.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom's Saleh to address Thurs news conference.

text.p: DRB-Hicom managing director Saleh Sulong will address a news conference on Thursday to discuss the company's direction after the death of chairman Yahaya Ahmad, the company said.

"The DRB-Hicom group will be holding a press conference on March 6, 1996 to brief members of the mass media on the group's direction after the recent and sudden demise of chairman," the statement said.
Saleh, widely tipped to take over chairmanship of the vehicle-based industrial group, will start the meeting at 5.30 p.m. (0930 GMT).
Ahmad, chairman of The Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB) and Hicom Holdings Bhd group of companies, died in a helicopter crash on Monday.
The stocks of nine companies directly linked to Yahaya have been suspended since Tuesday following his death.
